description: A stacked bar chart whose tooltip shows an icon for each series in place of a color swatch.
overview: A stacked bar chart whose tooltip shows a small icon for each series instead of a color swatch. Use icons when series map to recognizable things, like device types, and color alone isn't enough to tell them apart.
usage: Add an `icon` component to each series entry in `chartConfig`; the tooltip picks it up automatically. Replace `chartData` and the series keys to match your data.
notes: Icons replace the color indicator in every tooltip and legend that uses this config, so add them only where you want them everywhere. The tooltip opens on a preset month when the chart loads.
